messages:
maria: FYI - seeing a sustained spike in spot evictions in eu-west-1 (A100 pools). 6h avg ~12% vs normal ~3%. Looks correlated with a big HPC launch. Thinking: regional bid-skew + small warmbuffer + soft-evict to protect latency SLOs. input?

ashok: saw the same alerts. My proposal: move prod-critical lanes to capacity-optimized pools where possible, keep price-optimized for dev/batch. Add zone spread so a single AZ churn doesn't take down a whole pool.

liam: agree with ash. Also propose a tiny on-demand warm pool (5-10% of prod capacity) we only spin into when eviction rate > threshold. cheap insurance for tail latency and KV cache preservation.

eve: autoscaler changes: avoid scale-to-zero immediately on spot reclaim. add a soft-evict TTL (3m) so we can drain in-flight requests and flush/serialize KV cache. that should reduce 5xx spikes.

maria: liam - can you sketch the bid-skew / pool weights so i can eyeball tradeoffs (region vs price)?

liam: quick prototype config we ran in staging (pseudofmt):
```
pools:
  - name: prod-eu, strategy: capacity-optimized, weight: 0.7, fallback: [prod-eu-quant, prod-us]
  - name: batch-eu, strategy: price-optimized, weight: 0.2
  - name: warmbuffer-ondemand, strategy: on-demand, weight: 0.1
eviction_ttl_sec: 180
spill_threshold: 0.08  # fraction of pool evicted to trigger warmbuffer
```
This biases prod to capacity pools, keeps a small ondemand backstop.

ashok: note: capacity-optimized still thins when whole region is noisy. add cross-region fallback order that prefers same continent (eu-west-1 -> eu-west-2 -> eu-central-1 -> us) so latency stays bounded. also prefer instance-family fallback (A100 -> A10x/G5) for quantizable workloads.

sre-bot: alert: eviction_rate(eu-west-1,a100)=12.4% (6h avg). rolling median latency spike observed: +210ms. Incident created: INC-2024-219.

eve: on instance-family fallback: we must ensure runtime supports lower-precision variants and that session KV cache can be restored or migrated. otherwise fallbacks will cause contextual mismatch.

liam: agree - need a test harness for cross-variant KV serialization. also add a flag on session to record fallback model id so client-side can decode if needed.

maria: proposed action items:
- ashok: implement cross-region fallback ordering and zone-spread for P0 prod pools (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- liam: build warmbuffer prototype in staging, validate TTL behaviour and ondemand cost impact (ETA: 48h)
- eve: update autoscaler to honour soft-evict TTL and emit metric for drained in-flight requests (ETA: 72h)
- infra: add runbook entry and update oncall checklist with warmbuffer failover steps

ashok: ack. i'll also run a quick sim (eviction vs warmbuffer size) and post numbers.

liam: starting staging deploy now. heads-up: allow +20% quota headroom for warmbuffer trial so we don't hit cloud quotas during exercise.

maria: solid. if staging looks good we can canary to a single AZ in prod. thanks team :thumbsup:

sre-bot: note: ticket infra#4521 "regional bid skew + warmbuffer prototype" created and assigned to ashok/liam/eve.
